scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @shop/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @shop/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @shop/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @shop/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @shop/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build --workspace @shop/contracts && npm run test --workspace @shop/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @shop/contracts && npm run build --workspace @shop/api && npm run build --workspace @shop/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @shop/contracts && npm run build --workspace @shop/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @shop/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @shop/web
